content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Cutting tools, first aid and safety products sold to retailers and institutions; no connected fitness hardware or subscriptions."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Protein shakes, powders and bars sold as packaged nutrition; not connected fitness equipment or streaming classes."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Payment and telemetry systems for vending and unattended retail operators; no consumer fitness products or classes."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Branded household, personal care and vitamin products sold through mass retail; no fitness equipment or subscriptions."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Corporate leadership training, consulting and planners; no consumer fitness hardware or workout content."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale apparel and footwear sold to department stores; Peloton's apparel is a side line, not its core business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"B2B online marketplace reselling bulk furniture and goods to businesses; not a direct-to-consumer fitness equipment seller."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Ad-supported digital media earning advertising and affiliate commissions; no equipment sales or paid member subscriptions."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale lifestyle apparel and footwear brands plus restaurants; no connected fitness equipment or streaming classes."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sports and lifestyle publisher earning advertising and affiliate revenue; no hardware or paid streaming workouts."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Branded packaged snacks and protein shakes sold through grocery retail; no fitness hardware or class subscriptions."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket operator selling groceries, pharmacy and fuel to households; no fitness equipment or subscription content."}]}
